### Fixes
- Fixed a data-loss bug where each update after the first overwrote the vanilla
  `start_protected_game.exe.backup` with the mod launcher, leaving no local copy
  of the original game executable. The backup is now created once and never
  overwritten.

### Improvements
- Much smarter game detection: scans all native and Flatpak Steam roots and
  parses each `libraryfolders.vdf`, so installs on secondary drives and custom
  Steam libraries are found. Prompts you to choose when multiple installs exist.
- Added a dependency check that fails fast with install hints if `curl`, `wget`,
  `unzip`, or `jq` are missing.
- Temp download now uses a secure `mktemp` file, cleaned up automatically on
  success, failure, or interruption.
- Settings are backed up with copy (not move), so your settings survive an
  interrupted run.

### Docs
- README updated: corrected the release asset name (`Seamless.Co-op.*.zip`) and
  documented the new multi-library detection.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/youp211/ERSC-Updater-Linux/compare/2.1...2.2
